desc: Implement digit-length counts cnt[d], sumVal[d], and q[d]=10^d mod 998244353 for active digit lengths.
Precompute fact[0..N] and modular inverses inv[1..N] modulo 998244353.
Build Q(z)=∏(1+q_d z) and R(z)=∑ cnt_d q_d Q/(1+q_d z) over active digit lengths.
Use the recurrence from QP'=RP to compute coefficients e[0..N] of P(z) in O(N·D).
For each active digit length d, recover coefficients of P(z)/(1+q_d z) sequentially, compute F_d=Σ fact[k]·fact[N-1-k]·coeff[k], and accumulate sumVal[d]·F_d.
Print the final accumulated answer modulo 998244353 and verify the sample tests.
